integrity: Proof includes all support normalizations, exclusion implications and exact nonzero witnesses. Reproducibility is supplied by two executable checking programs and their captured outputs.
scientific_limitations: Complete for exactly four nonzero arbitrary complex coefficients on the order-ten dihedral group only. No all-dihedral generalization, singular-value conditioning bound, or probabilistic coefficient census is claimed. The finite-precision regular-matrix calculation is a corroborating check, not an exclusion proof. Literature-priority coverage remains bounded and independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Exact four-tap Fourier-rank geometry on the ten-element dihedral group
